blocks.text: Her latest track turns life’s highs, lows, mistakes, and heartbreaks into an empowering anthem of acceptance and self-reclamation. Nadine Lustre has released her new song “10YRS,” an introspective ballad that looks back on a decade of growth, heartbreak, mistakes, self-discovery, and transformation. Rather than dwelling on the past, “10YRS” embraces every experience, both difficult and beautiful, as essential to becoming the person she is today. The song traces Nadine’s journey toward letting go of what no longer serves her, reclaiming her identity, and looking ahead to what’s next.
